title: Josiah describes author Max Davis's popping house and nearby barn

tellings.quote: are you a barn man Max like there's animals or there's a Farm by you

plain: In a documentary called the Telepathy Tapes, about children said to read minds, the mother of a boy named Josiah tells how Josiah described the house of an author, Max Davis, as a house that makes popping sounds, with a barn nearby. She recalls asking Max whether he was a barn man, with animals or a farm close by. If true, it would mean the boy picked up details of a place he had never seen.
